d:
Build full-body strength and muscular endurance in just 20 minutes with this military-style calisthenics workout you can do anywhere — no gym, no weights, and no equipment required.
This beginner-to-intermediate 20-minute full-body workout uses military-inspired bodyweight exercises to strengthen your chest, triceps, legs, back, and core. We'll work for 40 seconds and rest for 20 seconds, giving you enough recovery to maintain proper form while challenging your muscular endurance, stability, and overall fitness.
WORKOUT
WARM-UP (4 MINUTES)
• March in Place + Arm Swings
